cpl.title: ATU Credit for Prior Learning: for students

regular_load_max.label: Recommended maximum load per fall/spring term
regular_load_max.note: More than 18 hours requires the dean's permission in advance.

overload_ceiling.label: Overload ceiling (fall, spring, or summer)
overload_ceiling.note: Absolute maximum with an approved overload petition.

overload_review_threshold.label: Loads above this need Academic Affairs review
overload_review_threshold.note: 19-21 hours: dean petition. 22-24 hours: dean petition plus Academic Affairs review.

overload_gpa_min.label: Overload eligibility: GPA in the preceding term
overload_gpa_min.note: Or good standing if the overload term is the final semester.

overload_prior_term_min_hours.label: Overload eligibility: ATU hours carried in the preceding term
overload_prior_term_min_hours.note: The 3.25 GPA must be earned on at least 12 ATU hours.

first_term_no_overload.label: No overload in the first ATU term
first_term_no_overload.note: A first term has no prior-term GPA, so the eligibility test can't be met (unless it is also the final semester).

probation_advisor_threshold.label: On probation: loads above this need advisor approval
probation_advisor_threshold.note: Shown as a warning only in v1.

workload_outside_per_credit.label: Study time outside class per credit hour
workload_outside_per_credit.note: Used for the weekly workload estimate.

standing_thresholds.label: Class standing by earned hours
standing_thresholds.note: Freshman under 30, sophomore 30-59, junior 60-89, senior 90+. The registrar's early-registration schedule uses the same bands.

standing_counts_exam_transfer.label: Class standing counts exam and transfer hours

residency_min_hours.label: Residency: minimum hours taken at ATU
residency_min_hours.note: Exam and transfer credit don't count toward residency.

residency_upper_major_hours.label: Residency: upper-division hours in the major taken at ATU

total_hours_min.label: Minimum total hours for a bachelor's degree
total_hours_min.note: A program may require more; the program's degree map wins.

upper_level_hours_min_default.label: Minimum 3000-4000 level hours (when a map doesn't state it)
upper_level_hours_min_default.note: Every 2026-27 bachelor's map that states this minimum states 40.

exam_credit_cap_hours.label: Cap on exam / prior-learning credit
exam_credit_cap_hours.note: CONFLICT: the 2026-2027 catalog (institutional credit and graduation requirements pages) allows up to 50% of a degree from correspondence, extension, military service, credit by examination, or credit for prior learning; www.atu.edu/admissions/credit.php says no more than 30 semester hours of correspondence, extension, military service, or credit by examination. Shortcut uses the stricter 30 hours so a plan never looks shorter than it is. Confirm with the registrar.

catalog_of_entry.label: Catalog you graduate under
catalog_of_entry.note: Students may graduate under the catalog in force when they first enroll, or any subsequent catalog, with the approval of the department head and dean.

exam_credit_gpa.label: Exam credit and GPA
exam_credit_gpa.note: Advanced credit is not used to calculate GPA, so it can't be used to retain scholarships. No duplicate credit for a course already graded.

ib_diploma_hours.label: IB Diploma credit
ib_diploma_hours.note: 24 hours of general education for a score of 4+ on each exam; possibly fewer otherwise. Not auto-mapped to courses in v1.

math_placement_act_min.label: Math ACT that satisfies the Calculus I prerequisite
math_placement_act_min.note: The CS degree map says 'Math ACT >26' (i.e. 27+); the catalog/Banner prerequisite says 26 or higher. Shortcut uses the stricter 27 from the map (PRD §8). Confirm with your advisor.

math_ladder.label: 'MATH 1113 or higher' ladder
math_ladder.note: Hand-maintained. Starts from Banner's own expansion of 'MATH 1113 or higher' for COMS 1013 (1113, 1914, 2223, 2243, 2914) and adds trigonometry (1203) and Calculus II/III. A ladder course satisfies any earlier rung.

summer_max_load.label: Planning cap for a summer (all sessions combined)

winter_max_courses.label: Planning cap for Winter Intersession: courses

winter_max_hours.label: Planning cap for Winter Intersession: hours

preferred_hours_default.label: Default preferred hours per regular term (standard pace)

summer_single_term.label: Summer sub-sessions are one planning term
summer_single_term.note: Simplification: May, June/July, 10-week, and July/August sessions are merged; no prerequisite chaining within a summer.

eight_week_sessions_modeled.label: 8-week sessions modeled
eight_week_sessions_modeled.note: Simplification: no prerequisite chaining within a fall or spring term.

transfer_rules.label: Summer transfer at another Arkansas public college
transfer_rules.note: Only ACTS-equivalent lower-level courses; they count toward total hours but not residency. Availability at the other college is assumed.

terms.label: Term structure
terms.note: Winter Intersession sits between fall and the following spring.

credit_for_prior_learning.label: Credit for Prior Learning (CPL)
credit_for_prior_learning.note: Shown as an informational card; never scheduled.
